entries.title: Ask HN: How to speak like a leader, not like an engineer?
entries.author: yogrish
entries.current_title: Ask HN: How to speak like a leader, not like an engineer?
entries.excerpt: I am a technical manager and currently in a leadership role. My manager who is an executive, keeps telling me“ don’t talk like an engineer, talk like a leader” when I go to him for any people or operational Issues. I always see from an engineer lens and possibly missing leader or executive perspective. How do I develop or change the way I talk as a leader. Did any one face this issue in the transition. Any pointers can be of great help.
entries.guide_zh: 被要求“像领导者那样说话”，技术经理怎样拓展工程师之外的管理视角？

entries.title: Ask HN: Resources/Steps for Becoming a Consultant?
entries.author: MichaelEstes
entries.current_title: Ask HN: Resources/Steps for Becoming a Consultant?
entries.excerpt: I recently put in my notice at work with nothing lined up. Do any of you operate full time as a consultant? I'd love to hear about how you got started and what resources, pitfalls, experiences you came across along the way.
entries.guide_zh: 已递辞呈却还没有下家，作者向全职顾问请教起步资源与常见陷阱。

entries.title: Ask HN: Physicists of HN, what are you working on these days?
entries.author: sachin18590
entries.current_title: Ask HN: Physicists of HN, what are you working on these days?
entries.excerpt: Of late, except for few headline-friendly fields (colliders, quantum computing, gravitational waves and astrophysics in general), I don't get to see/relate with a lot of activities in Physics. Also I have noticed a growing trend of physicists becoming data scientists post phD. Although I understand the money factor, are there any other reasons for this as well?
entries.guide_zh: 除了常上头条的方向，HN 上的物理学家最近都在研究什么？

entries.title: Ask HN: Tools or sites you use to scope out a workplace before taking a job?
entries.author: bwb
entries.current_title: Ask HN: Tools or sites you use to scope out a workplace before taking a job?
entries.excerpt: I'd love to know what everyone is doing to scope out a workplace before they take a job there. Do you email people who work there? Do you just jump in and hope for the best? Are there apps or sites you like?
entries.guide_zh: 接下工作以前，大家用哪些工具、网站或访谈方法了解真实职场？

entries.title: Ask HN: How to learn best practices when you have no one to teach you?
entries.author: bradhoffman
entries.current_title: Ask HN: How to learn best practices when you have no one to teach you?
entries.excerpt: I am currently working for a startup and am one of 3 developers. Most of my work revolves around building the API in Node + Express as well as some small projects with MongoDB. The other developers don't really assist me since they have their own projects to work on, and, honestly, they have less experience and knowledge than I do. So my question is: What is the best way for me to go about learning best practices in API development, or using MongoDB, or even just being a bett
entries.guide_zh: 小团队没人指导、同事也忙于别的项目，怎样学到可靠的开发实践？

entries.title: Ask HN: Who is hiring? (March 2019)
entries.author: whoishiring
entries.excerpt: Please state the job location and include the keywords REMOTE, INTERNS and/or VISA when the corresponding sort of candidate is welcome. When remote work is not an option, include ONSITE. Please only post if you personally are part of the hiring company—no recruiting firms or job boards. Only one post per company. If it isn't a household name, explain what your company does. Commenters: please don't reply to job posts to complain about something. It's off topic here. Readers:
entries.guide_zh: 三月招聘交流帖，请公司成员亲自介绍岗位、地点与远程等条件。

entries.current_title: Ask HN: What made you change your mind about a programming language/paradigm?
entries.excerpt: Books, courses, practical experiences or just a-ha moments that made you feel differently about a language/design pattern/etc.

entries.title: Ask HN: Startup failed after years of work – Can I even get a job now?
entries.author: perfect_loop
entries.current_title: Ask HN: Startup failed after years of work – Can I even get a job now?
entries.excerpt: I quit college to work on my startup. After 7 years of work, it's almost game over (will be shutting down in a few weeks). I haven't worked for anyone in years and I don't have a degree, but I've been coding for a long time, shipping real products to real customers... How do you think I should prepare for the job market? I'm 31 if it matters at all.
entries.guide_zh: 辍学创业七年即将关停，没有学历也久未受雇，该怎样重新求职？

entries.title: Ask HN: What are your best learning methods/hacks/tips?
entries.author: justaguyhere
entries.current_title: Ask HN: What are your best learning methods/hacks/tips?
entries.excerpt: Say you're learning something that is totally new to you and totally out of your comfort zone (Something like learning Chinese when the only language you can speak is English and you're a westerner, learning archery when you have been a couch potato for years etc). What would be your learning methods? Do you have any tips/hacks etc that works for you? Lets assume you are learning on your own, from books/videos etc, and not learning from a teacher
entries.guide_zh: 遇到完全陌生、超出舒适区的知识时，你最有效的学习办法是什么？

entries.title: Ask HN: Best questions for an engineer to ask a CEO during a job interview?
entries.author: northisup
entries.current_title: Ask HN: Best questions for an engineer to ask a CEO during a job interview?
entries.excerpt: I’m interviewing right now at a lot of startups and am looking for better ways to ask “so, where is this thing headed?” What do you always make sure to ask?
entries.guide_zh: 工程师面试创业公司时，该问 CEO 哪些问题才能看清公司的方向？
